scenarios: Alternating graceful stop and launcher SIGKILL
Stable hostname and reused private listener port across restarts
Fresh launcher instance identity per restart
Stale query callback affinity rejected; fresh state routed once
Peer and unrelated listener survive churn
Forced fixture gateway SIGKILL stops launchers and owned listeners
Fresh gateway startup rejects pre-restart state
Final gateway and listener ports released
limitations: Bounded fixture stress, not an overnight soak.
HTTP query-callback affinity only; no external provider authentication in this harness.
No stateful backend or database isolation journey.
Unix signal-injection test; Windows is skipped and macOS was not run.
Current working-tree CLI, not a packaged OSS consumer trial.
